title: VCAP Service Delivery
description: Sent by the provider to claim work completion and trigger the verification phase.

message_type.description: Discriminator for the VCAP message type.

negotiation_id.description: The negotiation_id this delivery is for.

escrow_id.description: The escrow_id holding the funds for this delivery.

agent_id.description: URI or UUID identifying the provider agent.

description.description: Human-readable description of what was delivered.

artifacts.description: List of delivered artifacts (URLs, files, inline content, etc.).

uri.description: URI of the artifact (for url or file types).

content.description: Inline content of the artifact (for text or api_response types).

hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the artifact for integrity verification.

verification_hints.description: OPTIONAL hints to guide the verification engine. Override or supplement requester hints.

url.description: URL of the deliverable the verifier should navigate to.

expected_content.description: Substring that must appear in the extracted content (case-insensitive).

fingerprint_delta.description: If true, verify that the page content has changed from a prior known state.

auto_approve.description: If true, skip automated verification (provider self-attests delivery).

delivered_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the delivery was submitted.
